definitions.explanation: A physics term for the pulling force transmitted along a string, rope, or surface, or the force resisting being stretched.

examples.japanese: ⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{張力|ちょうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Tension is applied to the rope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表面|ひょうめん}{張力|ちょうりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}いている→浮く：00413_uku⟧。
examples.english: The insect floats thanks to the surface tension of the water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧{張力|ちょうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大|おお}きすぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{切|き}れて→切れる：01936_kireru⟧しまう。
examples.english: If the tension on the thread is too great, the thread will snap.

notes:
Compound of {張|ちょう} (stretch, pull taut) + {力|りょく} (force). A technical term used mainly in physics and engineering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表面|ひょうめん}{張力|ちょうりょく}: surface tension
- {張力|ちょうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: tension is applied
- {張力|ちょうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧: to apply tensile force

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引力|いんりょく}→引力：25274_inryoku⟧: attractive force; gravitation — pulls objects together, not a force along a string
- ⟦{圧力|あつりょく}→圧力：12014_atsuryoku⟧: pressure — a pushing force per unit area, the opposite kind of stress
